name: Balanced Lattice
approvalNotes: Approved as composition A. Preserve the balanced three-column hierarchy, but replace the sharp drafting character with a smooth rounded system: continuous radii, softer panel transitions, restrained borders, and fluid hover/focus feedback.
prompt: High-fidelity north-star comp for XTab, composition A. Use the supplied DevStart screenshot as a structural and density reference only; do not copy its branding, blue accent, exact cards, people, names, data, or colored logos. Design a 1536x1024 landscape precision-monochrome Chrome new-tab workbench for geeks. Structure: low 72px header with geometric XTab wordmark left and GitHub connection plus light/dark toggle right; spacious command zone with a dominant centered search field and six quick-site controls; then a 23/54/23 three-column grid. Left is a dense RSS list with category tabs, center is a readable three-column GitHub recommendation grid, right is a signed-out GitHub panel with grayscale contribution preview and empty guidance. Light theme only: #F5F5F5 canvas, #FFFFFF and #FAFAFA surfaces, #E8E8E8/#D6D6D6/#A3A3A3 rules, #141414/#525252/#6B6B6B text, #171717 accent. Flat matte panels, precise 1px rules, 10-12px corners, near-zero shadow, sparse technical ticks, active states in black-white inversion. No fabricated readable metrics, usernames, headlines, or dates; only XTab, Search, RSS, and GitHub clearly readable. No gradients, glow, glass, colored icons, hero, illustration, photorealism, or watermark.
